text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm so pathetic, *hic*, I'm sh-shorry...!
I really wanted to be strong, just like you, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nah, when I first came to Japan,
there were times I wanted to go home, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, rather than being lonely, it was more like, 'Man, I really wanna eat that licorice candy they sold over there again.'

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That hits home, doesn't it... That nostalgic taste...
Ugh, Grandma's apple pie~~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ah, don't cry, don't cry, I'll cook for ya! Might not be as good as Grandma's, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, it's almost time for training...
If I don't wrap this up soon, I won't make it in time, but...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
When a cute junior cries,
you just can't leave her alone!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, lend a hand!
Let's enjoy them fresh off the grill together!

And so, Hishi Amazon ended up
neglecting her training.
